proposed_errata.rationale: PF statement consists solely of chondromalacia gradeI with no named classification, explicit superficial/intact cartilage statement, depth fraction or measured extent. Current negative uses a convention inference. Propose preserving uncertainty unless the independent adjudicator confirms that accepting an unnamed gradeI as below-threshold is intentional and supported. This is a conservative scope proposal, not a claim of proven positive cartilage loss.
